results.observation: Sending before join confirmation persists the message in the new room although the old room was still displayed.
A server rejection discards the draft with no pending message or retry.
Pasting an invite URL into the server field discards its room parameter.
The modal does not close on Escape and keyboard focus escapes into the background.
A rejected call-join leaves a live synthetic microphone but the UI shows no active call or leave control.
Preferences saved in localStorage disappear on restart because the local origin uses a new random port.
A server that accepts WebSocket but sends no hello leaves the entry form connecting forever beyond the configured timeout.
